design_decisions.intentional_subset: Parity is not equality. Every tools/skill.json capabilities[].module must be the authoritative_source of some NIZAM.json capability. NIZAM.json-only entries are allowed and must not fail the check. Equality would be wrong: NIZAM.json indexes non-routable artifacts (tools/validate.sh, tools/skill.json, tools/SKILL.md, tools/interface.md, standard/ci_gates.md, standard/mcp_policy.md, and others).
design_decisions.one_new_capability: The only new NIZAM.json capability is id nizam-ecosystem-bootstrap, authoritative_source ecosystem/00_ecosystem_bootstrap.md, inserted immediately before nizam-ecosystem-preflight. No other capability is added or rewritten. tools/skill.json already points at that module and is not edited.
design_decisions.extend_c13: The rule is added inside check_c13_skill_index, which already runs in the default sweep and in --payload. There is no new check function and no new [C17] (or C18 or C19) line. The banner stays exactly [C13] FAIL skill-index / [C13] PASS skill-index.
design_decisions.exact_membership: Membership is exact string equality between the module and authoritative_source, the same comparison as acceptance test 2. Paths are not normalized for this comparison. The existing resolution and payload carve-out stay as they are. The subset test still applies to a module the carve-out skipped, because NIZAM.json is injected and index membership is not file presence.
design_decisions.both_defects: A module that does not resolve and is also unindexed produces both the existing resolution line and the new subset line. The dangling fixture therefore gains a subset line for methodology/99_retired.md. Its OK line still depends only on the [C13] FAIL banner.

A later change cannot satisfy acceptance test 4 or the new OK line by printing [C17] FAIL or by failing only C4: S05 case 4 deletes that one line and requires [C13] FAIL to disappear while [C4] FAIL remains.

pinned_interface.subset_block:
# Intentional subset, not equality (phase-014 feature 106, NDEBT-044 a).
# Every capabilities[].module string must be exactly the authoritative_source
# of some NIZAM.json capability (the same strings acceptance test 2 compares).
# NIZAM.json-only capabilities are allowed. The comparison is not normalized
# and it runs in every mode, including a module the payload resolution
# carve-out skipped. A module that already failed to resolve is still
# reported here when it is also unindexed.
try:
    with open("NIZAM.json", encoding="utf-8") as index_file:
        capability_index = json.load(index_file)
except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
    print(f"NIZAM.json unreadable or not valid JSON: {exc}")
    sys.exit(1)
indexed_sources = set()
index_capabilities = capability_index.get("capabilities") if isinstance(capability_index, dict) else None
if isinstance(index_capabilities, list):
    for index_capability in index_capabilities:
        authoritative_source = index_capability.get("authoritative_source") if isinstance(index_capability, dict) else None
        if isinstance(authoritative_source, str) and authoritative_source:
            indexed_sources.add(authoritative_source)
for index, capability in enumerate(capabilities):
    module = capability.get("module") if isinstance(capability, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(module, str) or not module:
        continue
    if module not in indexed_sources:
        label = f"capabilities[{index}] ({capability.get('name', '?') if isinstance(capability, dict) else '?'})"
        problems.append(f"{label} -> {module} is not the authoritative_source of any NIZAM.json capability")
pinned_interface.test_c13:
test_c13() {
  note_covered skill_index_neg_dangling_module.json
  note_covered skill_index_neg_unindexed_capability.json
  SKILL_BAK=$(mktemp)
  cp -- tools/skill.json "${SKILL_BAK}"
  _c13_substitute_one() {
    local fixture_basename="$1"
    local required_detail="$2"
    local validator_output
    cp -- "tools/fixtures/${fixture_basename}" tools/skill.json
    validator_output=$(bash tools/validate.sh 2>&1)
    cp -- "${SKILL_BAK}" tools/skill.json
    if printf '%s\n' "${validator_output}" | grep -Eq "^\[C13\] FAIL" \
      && { [ -z "${required_detail}" ] || printf '%s\n' "${validator_output}" | grep -Fq -- "${required_detail}"; }; then
      echo "OK   c13-substitute ${fixture_basename} -> [C13] FAIL"
    else
      echo "FAIL c13-substitute: substituting ${fixture_basename} did not yield [C13] FAIL"
      fail=1
    fi
  }
  _c13_substitute_one skill_index_neg_dangling_module.json ""
  _c13_substitute_one skill_index_neg_unindexed_capability.json "is not the authoritative_source of any NIZAM.json capability"
  rm -f -- "${SKILL_BAK}"
  SKILL_BAK=""
}

design_notes.serialization: Do not run tools/validate.sh and tools/fixtures_self_test.sh at the same time, in this tree or in one scratch copy. The self-test copies a fixture over tools/skill.json. S05 starts with a /proc refusal (exit 4) and then runs its seven scratch cases one at a time. scratch_run copies the tree and does not write the real tree. Do not take a scratch copy while either script is running in the source tree.
hazards: 1. NDEBT-047, not fixed. test_c13 still restores tools/skill.json only on the straight-line path. The function is not allowed to install a trap, and cleanup, scratch_dirs, and the line-473 call stay byte-identical (they sit outside the replaced function). The second substitution lengthens the window: an interrupt during either validate.sh can leave tools/skill.json swapped. Restore only with `git checkout <B> -- tools/skill.json` inside the attempt root. Do not 'fix' the trap while implementing 106.

2. AT4's [C4] FAIL is expected after implementation as well as before. methodology/00_planning_moved.md does not exist, so C4 fails. C13 must additionally fail because methodology/00_planning.md is no longer an authoritative_source. Do not suppress C4, and do not make C13 fail merely because a NIZAM.json path is missing. S05 case 4 is the control: with the subset line deleted, [C13] FAIL is gone and [C4] FAIL remains.
3. The negative fixture stays negative only while ecosystem/README.md is not an authoritative_source. This feature adds no other capability. Indexing that README would make the fixture pass C13.
4. Acceptance test 5 forbids a new check id in validator stdout. Adding C17 would not, by itself, fail the validator_gate baseline subset test. Do not add a check.
5. Evidence files: line 1 is the invocation, the body is raw output, the last line is EXIT:<code> from the process. No `| tee` and no `| grep` on a capture.
6. The untracked .nizam/ directory in the shared tree is not part of this feature. git worktree add does not copy it. Do not add it, and do not run S03 in a tree where it is untracked.

7. C9 extracts slash-qualified path tokens from tools/README.md. The pinned rows add no new token. The help addition is in tools/validate.sh, which C9 does not scan. The CHANGELOG bullet's paths exist once the fixture exists.
